events.verdict: Mitchell (MIA) rests his hands on Edwards' (DAL) back without applying force during the rebound.
Ware (MIA) initiates contact with Marshall's (DAL) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Exum (DAL) loses his balance as Herro (MIA) releases away on the perimeter. The ensuing foot contact between the two players is marginal.
Exum (DAL) avoids making any illegal contact with Herro (MIA) during his jump shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) reaches in and makes contact to Exum's (DAL) wrist, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Dinwiddie (DAL) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Exum (DAL) legally contests Robinson's (MIA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Edwards (DAL) briefly engages with Anderson (MIA) on the perimeter.
Christie (DAL) initiates contact with Burks' (MIA) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Marshall (DAL) throws the ball off of the basket stanchion and is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Christie's (DAL) shot attempt fails to make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Jovic (MIA) turns away from Christie (DAL) and establishes himself in a screening position in his path after handing the ball off.
Exum (DAL) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Anderson (MIA) commits a take foul on Dinwiddie (DAL).
